page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-48-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 378.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include any GPU accelerators.

A defining characteristic of this server is its integrated local storage subsystem. It is equipped with 11,274 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, distributed across three physical local SSD drives. This high-capacity local storage is bundled directly with the instance, offering low-latency and high-throughput data access. The virtual machine does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the z4d-highmem-48-standardlssd offers high resource density by combining a substantial memory footprint with massive local NVMe storage capacity. This profile is designed for workloads requiring high-speed local data access without the latency of network-attached storage. Appropriate workloads include large-scale relational and non-relational databases, data warehousing, real-time analytics, and memory-intensive transactional processing.
